scope_note: The work inventory shows that citing Die Traumdeutung without an edition can conceal textual growth; this claim does not enumerate every line-level change.
statement: The Freud Edition records eight German editions of Die Traumdeutung from the 1900 first edition through the altered eighth edition of 1930.
statement_zh: Freud Edition 記錄《夢的解析》從 1900 年初版到 1930 年改訂第八版，共有八個德文版本。
